verdict.rationale: Relay documents its own bookkeeping automations: receipt capture, real-time expense categorization, automatic sync to accounting software, and detailed transaction syncing into QuickBooks Online and Xero. These plausibly speed up month-end close, but nothing in the evidence describes AI-driven automation or month-end close workflows specifically. Missing for 10: any evidence the automations are AI-powered (e.g., AI categorization or reconciliation), documented month-end close or reconciliation features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of faster closes.
